summary: This note is a short biographical entry on James Hannell (1813–1876), an auctioneer and publican who became an Australian politician. It records that he was elected to the New South Wales Legislative Assembly and served as the first Mayor of Newcastle and the first Mayor of Wickham.
one_line: James Hannell (1813–1876) was a New South Wales auctioneer, publican, politician and the first mayor of Newcastle and Wickham.
key_facts: James Hannell was born on 1 December 1813.
James Hannell was an auctioneer and publican.
James Hannell was an Australian politician.
James Hannell was elected as a member of the New South Wales Legislative Assembly.
James Hannell was the first Mayor of Newcastle.
James Hannell was the first Mayor of Wickham.
